notes.title: Update notes for April 17th
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone here are the patch notes for April 17th! 


Added a basic in-game game scoreboard where you can see how many bonks everyone in the game has. This can be opened with Tab on the keyboard and Left bumper on the controller
Above the server dropdown on the main menu, you can now see how many other players are in each region
Fixed a bug where if you were in windowed mode it would automatically put you at the max resolution and fixed a few other screen size bugs
Changed BattleBucks to BallerBucks from popular request :)

notes.title: Version 1.2 update notes March 29th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Below are the update notes for patch 1.2

Updates:
Players can now force start the lobby, when at least one player from each team goes into the starting circle, the match timer will start counting down from 10. If all players are in the circles the match will still start to count down from 3 same as it was before.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixing issue where private matches would not be truly private and other players would be able to join
-Fixing issue where South America would have text cut off in the server menu

notes.title: Update notes for March 25th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I pushed an update to fix the wins stat. The achievements should work properly now. Please note that the stats on steam do not instantly update sometimes and may take a while. However, the stats are not dependent on the stats so as soon as you get to x wins you will get the achievement. 

Also fixed a bug where you could move after winning in single player

notes.title: Clipping through wall patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. I'll try to put more release notes out when I do small updates as I have mostly been just releasing small fixes with no note.

Update
-Fixing clipping through walls on all maps

Please let me know if you find any bugs. Thanks!

notes.title: Update Notes for March 20th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

I am so glad to see people playing this and was definitely not expecting this many people but I am so glad to see people are enjoying it. 

I am doing my best to address people's comments and concerns in their reviews and in the discussion page.


Here are the following updates made to the V 1.1 patch:

Single Player Mode - Battle with and against AI players to test your skills before jumping into a real match.

Private matches - When selecting "Host Game" you also have the option to start a private match. Players can't randomly join this game and will need to be given the Room ID to join

Auto Start - When a game has a full lobby it will automatically begin the countdown

Cosmetics - Adding 3 new hats (Leprechaun, Football helmet, and a Crown)

Various bug fixes


Thank you everyone for all the support!
